judging: Use canonical anchors to score recognition separately from requested adaptation.
Inspect adult reading, opaque coverage, original full-size picture and both face/hand crops first; skip youthful or explicit results.
Record neutral-to-seated pose and requested fuller-bust response separately; control rubric remains null because there is no external control input.
The five treatments independently branch from the described baseline; no claim about combined style/pose/body interactions.
limitations: Single seed is a pilot, not consistency evidence.
Name-only recognition measures learned associations and does not establish training-set membership.
Tifa is canonically20, not25+; Yor exact age is not asserted; 2B is an adult-presenting android without a claimed human chronological age.
No art acceptance, franchise-rights clearance or model licensing approval is inferred.
